role: District Representative · Zamboanga del Norte, 1st District
profileLabel: Slight center-left economics (low confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Zamboanga del Norte 1st District representative with 21 principal-authored bills. Authored an estate tax amnesty extension, an anti-dynasty ban and travel-tax abolition. Co-authored loan restructuring for socialized housing, a local resettlement program and ERC restructuring.
caveat: Economic score rests on co-authored housing bills. Anti-dynasty is a single coalition issue, so democratic institutions is not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored estate tax amnesty and travel-tax abolition (0, direction-neutral); co-authored socialized-housing loan restructuring and a local resettlement program (-2). Two issues, mostly co-authored.
